# Clearview Cleaning Co.

> Professional home and commercial cleaning services across the San Francisco Bay Area since 2011. Bonded, insured, no hidden fees.

## Services

- **Fresh Home** ($299/visit): Full home clean up to 2,000 sq ft — kitchen, bathrooms, floors, interior windows
- **Complete Care** ($399/visit): Deep clean, interior + exterior windows, carpet extraction, priority scheduling
- **Business Clean** ($399/service): Office janitorial, common areas, restrooms, trash and recycling
- **Facility Pro** ($549/service): Full commercial service — floor waxing, window cleaning, carpet extraction, dedicated account manager

## Contact

- Phone: (415) 555-0184
- Email: hello@clearview.co
- Hours: Monday–Friday, 8am–6pm
- Area: San Francisco · Marin · East Bay

## Requesting a Quote

Visit the website and use the "Request a Quote" form. Select Home or Business, provide your name, email, and details about your space. We respond within one business day.
